steps.hook: When you laugh at a joke you didn't hear because asking "what?" twice feels dangerous.

steps.alt_text: Man silent while others around him talk dark cinematic. Overlay text r...

steps.caption:
That laugh wasn't you being fake. It was you choosing a small shame now to avoid a bigger exposure later. That's what social anxiety does — it turns asking "what?" twice into a threat, so your nervous system makes you nod and fake it before you even get a vote.
If you do this, you're not alone. If you laugh at jokes you didn't hear and replay their faces for ten minutes after, checking if they saw through you, it's not because you don't care. It's because your brain would rather be invisible than be seen trying. Comment HEARD and I'll send you the full breakdown.
#socialanxiety #overthinking #socialanxietystruggles #anxietyproblems #introvertstruggles #quietpeople #latenightthoughts
